name: PREDICTION: BEV Supply Chain Second Wave — Gigafactory Graveyard

trigger.description: BEV demand destruction + $50B+ in battery gigafactory investments becoming stranded assets as OEMs pivot to hybrids. Second-tier suppliers and mining communities face the full delayed impact.

reasoning: The first wave (OEM write-downs, Tier-1 layoffs) is confirmed. But the SECOND wave hasn't hit yet. Battery gigafactories built on 2021-2023 demand forecasts are now operating at 20-40% capacity. Second-tier suppliers (smaller than Bosch/Continental) lack cash reserves to survive. Mining communities in Congo experienced initial price shock but the full humanitarian cascade — food insecurity, health collapse, displacement — has a 6-12 month delay from income loss (per CascadeAI's JOBS->HEALTH delay of 60-180 days).

predictions.prediction: Acute malnutrition rates in Lualaba/Haut-Katanga mining districts will exceed emergency threshold (15% GAM) by Q4 2026
predictions.mechanism: ECONOMY(-40% cobalt) -> JOBS(miners income halved) -> FOOD(+18% maize, confirmed) -> HEALTH(malnutrition, 60-90 day delay from food stress)
predictions.delay_from_trigger: 120-180 days from income loss (Q3 2025 + 6 months = Q1-Q2 2026, emerging now)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: WFP VAM food security monitoring; UNICEF nutrition surveys; MSF field reports
predictions.confidence: HIGH — food price increase already confirmed; health impact follows with known delay

predictions.prediction: 50,000-100,000 economic migrants from Katanga mining belt to Lubumbashi/Kinshasa by end of 2026
predictions.mechanism: JOBS(mining collapse) -> DISPLACEMENT(economic migration, 60-180 day delay)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: IOM displacement tracking; UNHCR; DRC census bureau
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH — initial migration already reported by IOM; scale prediction requires monitoring

predictions.prediction: $15-25B in stranded nickel processing assets in Sulawesi by Q1 2027 as Chinese HPAL/smelter projects are abandoned
predictions.mechanism: US 145% tariff on Chinese batteries -> Chinese nickel processors lose primary market -> Sulawesi industrial parks become stranded
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Bloomberg; Indonesian Ministry of Industry reports; Sulawesi industrial park utilization data
predictions.confidence: HIGH — $8B already at risk (confirmed); additional projects in pipeline will follow

predictions.prediction: Environmental health crisis in Sulawesi as abandoned smelters leak heavy metals into water systems; respiratory illness +20-30% in Morowali district
predictions.mechanism: ECONOMY(stranded assets) -> JOBS(workers leave) -> WATER(unmonitored tailings) -> HEALTH(contamination)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Indonesian EPA monitoring; Greenpeace Indonesia; WHO water quality data
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM — environmental monitoring already reduced at 4 sites (confirmed); contamination pathway is established

predictions.prediction: Water conflict intensifies in Atacama as shuttered lithium operations leave brine extraction sites unmanaged, threatening indigenous Atacameno water access
predictions.mechanism: ECONOMY(lithium price collapse) -> JOBS(mine closures) -> WATER(abandoned brine extraction alters water table)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Chilean water authority (DGA); Atacameno community statements; SQM/Albemarle environmental reports
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM — water stress already severe in Atacama; mine closure procedures unclear

compound_prediction.description: COMPOUND: BEV Second Wave + Sudan War create overlapping displacement
compound_prediction.prediction: Congolese miners displaced by cobalt crash overlap with Sudanese refugees in eastern DRC, compounding existing 6.9M IDP crisis. Total DRC displacement exceeds 8M by Q1 2027.
compound_prediction.mechanism: BEV ECONOMY->JOBS->DISPLACEMENT converges with SUDAN WAR->DISPLACEMENT in same geographic region
compound_prediction.confidence: MEDIUM — both cascades are active; convergence geography is plausible
